row.evidence: Tugboat Logic was acquired by OneTrust and is now sold as OneTrust Compliance Automation in the quote-only Tech Risk & Compliance package ('Get Pricing'); OneTrust's developer portal documents SCIM 2.0 'so that you can automatically provision and deprovision users within the OneTrust application'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Tugboat Logic was acquired by OneTrust (announced 2021); tugboatlogic.com redirects to onetrust.com, support.tugboatlogic.com redirects to the OneTrust 'Certification Automation' help topic, and app.tugboatlogic.com no longer resolves. The product is now OneTrust Compliance Automation inside the Tech Risk & Compliance package, which the pricing page sells only via 'Get Pricing'. Its API sits on the same OneTrust tenant host (https://{hostname}/api/compliance-wr) as OneTrust's platform SCIM 2.0 User Provisioning API (OAuth client-credentials with the SCIM scope; deprovisioning = deactivate via PATCH; DELETE not available). That SCIM covers Compliance Automation users is inferred from the shared platform, not stated on a Compliance Automation page. Okta's OneTrust OIN app is SAML plus a Workflows connector (no SCIM tick). Recommend merging this row into the onetrust row (same status).

auth.token_source: OneTrust Global Settings API client with the SCIM scope

roles.how: New users get the default role and organization from Global Settings > User Provisioning; legacy SCIM groups are role-organization combinations.

rate_limits.text: User Provisioning API quota: 2k calls/minute, 20k calls/hour.

scim.notes: Tugboat Logic no longer exists as a separate product: it is OneTrust Compliance Automation (Tech Risk & Compliance), whose API is served from the same OneTrust tenant host as the platform SCIM API. SCIM is OneTrust's platform-wide User Provisioning API (legacy /api/scim/v2 and enhanced /api/scim/v3); full detail is in the onetrust row.

user_api.notes: See the onetrust row: OneTrust's Access Management API covers users, groups and roles platform-wide. Not re-researched here.

okta.notes: OIN 'OneTrust' app ticks SAML and Workflows Connectors only (read from page markup); no Tugboat Logic app (okta.com/integrations/tugboat-logic/ 404).

entra.notes: No Tugboat Logic tutorial in the Entra list; the OneTrust Privacy Management Software tutorial covers SSO with JIT (see onetrust row).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud has an 'Integrate with OneTrust' guide (not reviewed here); no Tugboat Logic guide.
